ios.desc:
Chatlo turns your iPhone into a true AI powerhouse. Stop juggling multiple apps—bring your favorite models together, get things done locally or in the cloud, and keep your data 100% private.

[ ONE APP, ALL YOUR MODELS ]
No more switching between different apps. Chatlo connects directly to the AI models you already use and trust.
- Bring your own API keys for DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Qwen, and more.
- Direct connection with zero markup or middleman fees.
- Switch models anytime, or run lightweight models locally offline with NanoJev MLX.

[ BUILT TO GET THINGS DONE ]
Chatlo goes beyond simple chat to help you tackle real work.
- Research topics, analyze long articles, and summarize key points instantly.
- Plan schedules, organize to-dos, and manage your daily workflows.
- Connect AI directly with your iPhone: trigger Shortcuts, check Health data with your permission.

[ YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS ]
Privacy isn't an afterthought; it's the core.
- API keys are stored securely on your device.
- No Chatlo backend servers tracking your chats.
- Run entirely offline when you need total privacy.

Chatlo — from asking to getting things done.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Chatlo – an iOS-native AI agent, now with Jev

quotes.text:
Hello HN!

I’m sure many of you have used AI agent apps like OpenClaw, Claude Code, or Codex on your PCs, but you rarely see AI agents running on the iOS platform. That’s why I created an agent app that runs exclusively on iOS—it doesn’t require a separate computer or server; it runs entirely on your iPhone.

Plus, in the latest version, we’ve become the first to integrate Jev AI—a very popular decision-making AI—on the App Store.

We invite you to try it out, and we look forward to your feedback.

App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chatlo-ai-chat-agent/id6771188943
